research_find.title: S&P 500 Risk-On Rotation Continues as Tech Leads Rally
research_find.description: U.S. stocks closed higher Tuesday with the S&P 500 up 1.2% to 5,847 as technology shares led the advance. The risk-on rotation reflects strengthening earnings forecasts and a slightly more dovish Fed posture after April CPI came in below expectations. Mega-cap technology gained over 2% on the session, driving the Nasdaq 100 to a fresh all-time high. Energy lagged amid soft crude inventories. Bond yields slipped with the 10-year Treasury yield closing at 4.32%, four basis points lower. Volume on the NYSE was below the 20-day average. Strategists at Goldman Sachs note that risk appetite remains constructive into the May FOMC meeting, with positioning still light by historical standards.
